name: Ariake-Tennis-No-Mori
tagline: Tokyo in 28 minutes and Otemachi in 29 minutes. Served by 1 line.
summary: The station is in Koto City, served by Yurikamome. Journey times to the main business districts are 29 minutes to Otemachi, 41 minutes to Shinjuku, 40 minutes to Shibuya and 39 minutes to Shinagawa. The station stands 4.9 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 5.9 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 4.9 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from -0.6 m to 5.3 m, a difference of 5.9 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, neither the station nor any of the nine points within 400 m of it falls inside the projected inundation area. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

groceries.name: イオンスタイル 有明ガーデン

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 1 pharmacy. The nearest hospital is 癌研有明病院, about 14 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 昭和医科大学江東豊洲病院, about 22 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
congestion: Yurikamome runs at 92% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 汐留→竹芝, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, 1K ¥180,000 to ¥190,000 and 1LDK ¥200,000 to ¥210,000. 2LDK ¥310,000 to ¥320,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: Kokusai-Tenjijo is ahead on how close the centre is, but Ariake-Tennis-No-Mori is ahead on quiet.

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 3 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 7 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Neither the station nor the ground around it falls inside the projected flood area.
leads.stationNote: Only the Yurikamome serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
